description: Call this FIRST, before writing or deploying code. Returns the signed-in sota.io account: plan limits (projects, databases, memory per app, upload size), whether it is a sota Enterprise account (company label, app URL scheme https://<app>.<label>.sota.io, own server, sign-in connection status, the dashboard page where the owner grants access) and the build contract the app must follow: one container, PORT, health gate, database through PgBouncer, upload rules, and for Enterprise the identity headers, fail-closed rule, health-without-identity rule and what the human must do before anyone can open the app. Read-only.
name: get-account
